stem: Which statement explains the purpose of military government in the South during Reconstruction?

options.label: A
options.text: It prevented carpetbaggers from operating former Confederate businesses.

options.label: B
options.text: It protected and ensured the rights of newly freed enslaved people.

options.label: C
options.text: It provided money and weapons to newly freed enslaved people.

options.label: D
options.text: It prohibited African Americans from running for public office.
